supporting_observations.claim: At 14:12:50 UTC, a Windows 4648 event on WS-ACOLE-01 records the SYSTEM account using explicit credentials targeting svc-grades in the ORCHARD domain on DC-ORC-01.

The event names C:\Program Files\Meridian\OpsAgent\ops-agent.exe as the process. The provided environment context describes GradeSync as running on FILE-ORC-01, so this event's host and process do not match the described GradeSync setup; this discrepancy is suspicious but does not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available evidence is a single 4648 event (T262-00034); it does not show whether authentication succeeded or failed.
No records are provided to confirm the alert's reported repeated failed logons around 13:40 UTC or to show the surrounding authentication sequence.
claims_not_established: Whether svc-grades had repeated failed logons around 13:40 UTC.
Whether the 14:12:50 explicit-credential attempt succeeded, failed, or was authorized.
Whether ops-agent.exe or its use of svc-grades was approved or expected on WS-ACOLE-01.
Whether the event is connected to the scheduled svc-grades password rotation or the GradeSync job.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain controller authentication records for svc-grades from 13:20 to 14:20 UTC, including success or failure status, source host, and logon type.
Process execution and parent-process telemetry for ops-agent.exe on WS-ACOLE-01 around 14:12 UTC, plus its file signature and installation or authorization records.
Evidence of the svc-grades password rotation and GradeSync job update, including any relevant activity on FILE-ORC-01.
